items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: My brother Henny played a Holton boy... All that stuff I do is for my brother Henny. That playing with the foot and Mike Ratton and all those guys are getting credit. My brother was the first one to do that.

ctx.x: Well, I had it fixed up. My brother Henny played a Holton boy and he had adhesive tape and everything and the holes and the slide and everything. There was the boy that played trombone when she was living. Oh, God.
Can you tell me a little bit more about him?
